_comment: StudySpec: what a study declares about itself before any outcome is read.
Today it carries only the attempt-selection policy. EnterpriseBench-rryas.11
extends this document with the rest of the Study Capsule (arms, repetitions,
model, harness revisions, score-contract version, authoritative usage source);
it is not a competing spec. Loaders read only the block they own, so a new
sibling block does not invalidate this file for an older reader.
attempt_policy.selection pins which attempt of a re-run (task_id, mode) cell
represents that cell. 'earliest_valid' is the only implemented value, and no
outcome-dependent value exists: selecting the highest-scoring attempt takes a
maximum over however many times a cell happened to be retried, and arms are
not retried equally, so the bias does not cancel in an arm-to-arm delta.
